# Queensland Public Service Salary Scales
## QLD Administrative Salary Guide by Classification
### AO 7 Salary — Administrative Officer Level 7
AnAO 7 (also written as AO7 or Administrative Officer Level 7) earns **$139,941–$149,933** gross — roughly $103,000–$109,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus12% employer super (~$157,000–$168,000 total package).

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the AO 7 salary?
An Administrative AO 7 (also written as AO7 or Administrative Officer Level 7) earns $139,941 to $149,933 per year as set by the Queensland Public Service Officers and Other Employees Award – State 2015 (reprinted 1 September 2026).
